headline: S&P GLOBAL: COPPER DEMAND RISES 50% BY 2040 — MINED SUPPLY EXPECTED TO PEAK AROUND 2030
snippet: A new S&P Global analysis projects copper demand will rise roughly 50% between 2025 and 2040 while mined supply is expected to peak around 2030 — meaning the structural supply deficit will widen regardless of short-term macro headwinds. The report adds long-term weight to the bull case for copper-focused juniors even as the metal retreats near $6.50/lb on rate fears.

headline: JAGUAR URANIUM FILES 14.3M LBS U3O8 MAIDEN RESOURCE AT LAGUNA SALADA — PLUS 88M LBS VANADIUM IN ARGENTINA
snippet: Jaguar Uranium published its maiden NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate for the Laguna Salada uranium-vanadium project in Chubut, Argentina: 4.2M lbs Indicated plus 10.1M lbs Inferred U3O8, alongside 31.1M lbs Indicated and 57.3M lbs Inferred V2O5. The resource footprint covers just 4.3% of the 210,284-hectare project, and the company holds US$18M cash with no debt to fund expansion drilling.

headline: GOLD STOCK CORRECTION 'FINALLY ENTERING END PHASE' — TANASHIAN MAKES THE CONTRARIAN BUY CASE
snippet: Technical analyst Gary Tanashian argues that the 2026 gold equity correction is in its final stage, with miners now discounting a post-CPI macro scenario that may prove more benign than markets fear. He identifies current price action as consistent with historical bottoming patterns that have preceded major rallies in HUI and GDX.

headline: GOLD BULLS SEE $5,400 WITHIN REACH — THOMSON ARGUES RALLY SETUP IS FORMING DESPITE CPI SHOCK
snippet: Stewart Thomson outlines a bull case for gold reaching $5,400 from current levels near $4,145, arguing that the CPI-driven selloff has created a high-risk/high-reward entry for investors with a 6-to-12-month horizon. Thomson identifies a series of technical supports and macro catalysts — including central bank accumulation and a potential Fed pivot — that he believes justify re-entering beaten-down gold equities.

headline: RECORD CENTRAL BANK GOLD BUYING ISN'T LIFTING MINERS — EQUITIES FALLING 2–5X HARDER THAN SPOT
snippet: Despite record central bank gold purchases throughout 2026, gold mining equities have declined two to five times harder than spot gold — a divergence Discovery Alert's analysts call unusual and unsustainable. The piece examines the macro, cost, and sentiment factors that have broken the traditional gold price/equity leverage relationship, and asks whether the correction represents a structural shift or a historic buying opportunity.

headline: MIDLAND EXPLORATION HITS GOLD-BEARING BOULDERS AT CANIAPISC — PHASE 1 TARGETS DELIVER IN JAMES BAY BELT
snippet: Midland Exploration (TSXV: MD) reported identification of new gold-bearing boulders during Phase 1 of its 2026 exploration program at the Caniapisc Au project in Quebec's James Bay territory. The boulder train discovery defines a new priority target for follow-up work, extending a corridor of mineralization in an increasingly active exploration district.

headline: MALAYSIA'S KING BUYS INTO RARE EARTH MINING FIRM — JOHOR PROJECT DRAWS ROYAL STRATEGIC INTEREST
snippet: Malaysia's king acquired a 2.25% stake in Southern Alliance Mining, which is expanding into rare earth processing through a project in the ruler's home state of Johor. The royal investment underscores Malaysia's accelerating push to become a non-Chinese rare earth processing hub, as Western defence contractors face January 2027 DFARS sourcing deadlines.
